name: Alpha-methyltryptophan
summary: α-Methyltryptophan (αMTP or α-MTP) is a synthetic tryptamine derivative, an artificial amino acid, and a prodrug of α-methylserotonin (αMS). It is the α-methylated derivative of tryptophan, while αMS is the α-methylated analogue of serotonin. αMTP has been suggested for potential therapeutic use in the treatment of conditions thought by some authors to be related to serotonin deficiency, such as depression.
